about: Things owners say, labelled by hand. 'stops' are real ways of asking not to be called. 'normal' is ordinary PG talk that must never be treated as a stop. Written by the developers, not from real calls. Every set EXCEPT 'holdout 5' was used to tune the patterns, so lexical scores on them are optimistic; holdout 5 was measured before any tuning on it and is the honest figure for phrasing the patterns have not seen. Add phrasings from real calls here first, fix the detector second.
